PLAN "12-Week Cycle-Synced Strength Program — Full Summary"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Phase-aligned strength progression with cycle-aware load management"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Week1 - Flow-safe intro":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 15 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          box_step 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 1:END
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Week2 - Flow-aware progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          rowing 12 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          broad_jump 3x4..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 2:END
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Week3 - Early-cycle peak (non-flow)":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
        cardio:
          jog_in_place 8 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          step_up_ jumptap 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 3:END
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Week4 - Deload before flow":
        warmup:
          jogging 4 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          elliptical 12 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          squat_jump 3x4..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 4:END
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks) with increased intensity:
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Phase2 Week1 - Post-flow re-entry (intensity up)":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 16 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          lunge_plyo_walk 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 5:END
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Phase2 Week2 - Off-flow strength push":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          row 12 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          tuck_jump 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 6:END
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Phase2 Week3 - Higher density strength":
        warmup:
          row 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          treadmill_walk_jog 12 minutes (alternating 2 min jog/2 min walk)
        plyo_power:
          lateral_bounds 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 7:END
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Phase2 Week4 - Flow-safe peak (intensity maintained)":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7.5 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          cycling 14 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          height_restricted_box_jump 3x4..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase3 Week1 - Pre-flow taper":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
          bench_press 5x5 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
          bent_over_row 5x5 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
        cardio:
          rowing 10 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          pogo_jumps 3x5 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 3 minutes
    WEEK 9:END
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase3 Week2 - Off-flow mid-build":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
          dumbbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
          cable_pulldown 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
        cardio:
          cycling 12 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          depth_jumps 3x4..6 rpe 7 rest 2 minutes
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 10:END
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase3 Week3 - Peak strength window":
        warmup:
          run 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 2 minutes
          bench_press 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 2 minutes
          barbell_row 4x4..6 rpe 8 rest 2 minutes
        cardio:
          elliptical 10 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          vertical_jump 3x4..6 rpe 8 rest 2 minutes
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
    WEEK 11:END
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Phase3 Week4 - Deload and consolidate + 1RM planning":
        warmup:
          walk 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cardio:
          walking 12 minutes zone 2
        plyo_power:
          clap_push_up_progression 3x4..6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 3 minutes

  1RM TESTING
    NOTES:
      - 1RM testing permitted after taper and medical clearance; scheduled end of Phase 3.
    TESTING_WINDOW:
      - Proposed date: end Phase 3 (Week 4 of Phase 3) on dedicated 1RM day.
    PROTOCOL:
      - Warmup: 5–10 minutes light cardio + mobility
      - Work up to 1RM across lifts (e.g., squat, bench_press, bent_over_row) with 3–5 minute rests between attempts
      - Maintain strict form; stop for pain or breakdown
      - If flow symptoms present, postpone 1RM

EXERCISES
  - Canonical names only; substitutions use allowed equivalents as needed

CARDIO OPTIMIZATION
  NOTES:
    - Zone 2 base development; non-flow days prioritized
    - Modify or skip cardio if flow symptoms worsen

HIIT MT DAY
  NOTES:
    - Biweekly HIIT on non-flow days; scale with cycle

PLYOMETRIC/POWER DAY
  NOTES:
    - Explosive work aligned with phase progression; protect joints during flow

PLYO/POWER EXAMPLE LIFT LIST
  PHASE 1: box_step, broad_jump, squat_jump
  PHASE 2: tuck_jump, lateral_bounds, height_restricted_box_jump
  PHASE 3: pogo_jumps, vertical_jump, squat_jump, clap_push_up_progression

NUTRITION_PLAN
  NOTES:
    - Cycle-aware fueling to support fatigue, cramps, and performance
  CALOR and MACRO TARGETS
    - Maintenance energy with 100–200 kcal adjustments as needed
    - Protein 1.6–2.2 g/kg
    - Carbohydrates 3–5 g/kg (higher on intense days)
    - Fats 0.8–1.0 g/kg
    - Fiber 25–38 g
    - Hydration 30–35 ml/kg

  FLOW-DAY and OFF-FLOW GUIDANCE
    - Flow days: emphasize electrolytes, iron, magnesium, calcium; moderate intensity
    - Off-flow: align macros with training load

  MICRO-NUTRITIONAL NEEDS
    - Iron, Magnesium, Calcium, Potassium, Vitamin D, B12/folate

  PRE-, POST-, SUPPLEMENTATION
    - Pre: protein + carbs
    - Post: protein + carbs + electrolytes
    - Supplements: Creatine 3–5 g/day; omega-3; iron if deficient; magnesium; vitamin D as needed

  SLEEP AND STRESS
    - 7–9 hours; magnesium/relaxation as needed

  SAMPLE DAY PLAN
    - Breakfast: oatmeal, milk, berries, protein
    - Snack: Greek yogurt + almonds
    - Lunch: chicken, quinoa, veggies, olive oil
    - Snack: banana + peanut butter
    - Dinner: salmon, sweet potato, greens

  ADJUSTMENTS
    - Modify intensity if fatigue/cramps worsen
    - Reassess macros every 4 weeks or with cycle shifts

END PLAN

    - Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight per day to support muscle repair.
    - Carbohydrates: 3–5 g/kg body weight per day, higher on heavier training days and lower on lighter or rest days.
    - Fats: 0.8–1.0 g/kg body weight per day.
    - Fiber: 25–38 g/day.
    - Hydration: aim for 30–35 ml/kg body weight per day, more with hotter weather or heavy sweating.

    - Flow days (days 1–3 of cycle): focus on moderate-intensity training with emphasis on electrolytes, hydration, and easily digestible meals. Prioritize iron, magnesium, potassium, calcium, and anti-inflammatory foods.
    - Off-flow days: standard macro targets with carbohydrates aligned to training load.

  MICRO-NUTRITIONAL NEEDS (daily)
    - Iron: if ferritin or iron status is low or if menstruation is heavy, include iron-rich foods (red meat, poultry, lentils, spinach) or a clinician-approved supplement.
    - Magnesium: 300–400 mg/day, may help with cramps and sleep quality.
    - Calcium: 1000–1300 mg/day; include dairy or fortified alternatives.
    - Potassium: 3200–4700 mg/day; include bananas, potatoes, yogurt, leafy greens.
    - Vitamin D: 600–2000 IU/day depending on sun exposure.
    - Vitamin B12 and folate: present in a balanced diet; consider fortified foods or a multivitamin if dietary intake is limited.

  FLOW-DAY SPECIFIC NUTRITIONAL STRATEGIES
    - Hydration: increase fluids; consider a beverage with electrolytes during flow days.
    - Iron-rich meals: include a source of heme iron with vitamin C-rich foods to aid absorption.
    - Magnesium-rich foods: nuts, seeds, whole grains, leafy greens to potentially reduce cramps.
    - Anti-inflammatory foods: fatty fish (or flax/chia), olive oil, turmeric; include at least one anti-inflammatory meal per day.
    - Simple carbohydrates: during heavy flow days if fatigue is high, include easy-to-digest carbs (rice, oats, bananas) to maintain energy.

  PRE-WORKOUT NUTRITION
    - 60–90 minutes pre-workout: a balanced meal with protein and carbohydrates (e.g., yogurt with oats and fruit, or chicken, rice, and vegetables).
    - If training in later day when appetite is suppressed, a small snack with 15–30 g protein and 30–40 g carbohydrates.

  POST-WORKOUT NUTRITION
    - Within 2 hours: 0.3 g/kg protein and 0.8 g/kg carbohydrate to support recovery.
    - Include a source of electrolytes if sweat rate is high.

  SUPPLEMENTATION (OPTIONAL, CONSULT clinician)
    - Creatine monohydrate: 3–5 g/day to support strength.
    - Omega-3 fatty acids: 1–3 g/day for inflammation management.
    - Iron supplementation: only if iron deficiency is diagnosed by a clinician.
    - Magnesium citrate or glycinate: 200–400 mg in the evening if cramps or sleep are an issue.
    - Vitamin D3: 600–2000 IU/day as per deficiency status.

  SLEEP AND STRESS
    - Target 7–9 hours of sleep per night.
    - Consider magnesium or calming bedtime routine to improve sleep quality during flow days when fatigue may be higher.

  MEAL PATTERNS AND TIMING
    - Meal timing: distribute protein evenly across 3–5 meals per day.
    - Quick snacks: keep portable protein sources handy (protein shake, yogurt, nuts, cheese, hard-boiled eggs).

  SAMPLE DAY PLAN
    - Breakfast: oatmeal with milk, berries, and a scoop of protein; optional nuts.
    - Snack: Greek yogurt with honey and almonds.
    - Lunch: grilled chicken, quinoa, mixed vegetables, olive oil drizzle.
    - Snack: banana and peanut butter.
    - Dinner: salmon, sweet potato, steamed broccoli.
    - Hydration: water + electrolyte drink on flow days.

  ADJUSTMENTS
    - If heavy fatigue or cramps persist, reduce intensity or swap main lifts to safer alternatives (e.g., goblet_squat for squat, incline_press for bench_press) while preserving overall weekly stimulus.
    - Reassess macro targets if weight change is not desired; adjust calories by ±200 kcal as needed.

NOTES
- Schedule modifications should be data-driven; track fatigue, cramps, and performance to fine-tune nutrition plan.
- The nutrition plan is integrated with the training phases; the macro targets should be revisited every 4 weeks or as cycle phases shift.

END PLAN
